decisions.reason: The existing message-54 MODIFY already captures the independently relevant national scope and site positioning; brand colors and cross-location visual branding remain owned by the brand-identity Requirement.
The existing message-54 MODIFY already captures consistent SMASH ROOM branding and addition of future locations without redesign.
The existing message-54 MODIFY already records cross-location design consistency and the visual-design clauses relevant to this Requirement; the specific brand colors belong to brand identity.
The message-54 INTRODUCE already records consistent design and branding across the dedicated location pages.
The branding changes do not alter the independently recorded mobile-friendly behavior.
Brand colors, consistency, and positioning do not change the selector options or routing behavior.
The brand-identity change does not alter the homepage section list or the requirement to display offerings.
The new branding details are within the transition already covered by the SEO-preservation goal but do not change that goal or its scope.
Consistent customer-facing branding does not change the required isolation of bookings, revenue, sales, calendars, or reporting.
Consistent branding across location pages does not necessarily change the separate Wix-site and account architecture.
The customer-facing brand identity does not change separate location payment setups or payout handling.
The brand-identity changes do not alter Wix as the booking platform or the use of sibling location sites for bookings.
